items.description: Wet sulfide damage applicability and test evidence
items.assessment_basis: Existing declared-envelope/evidence API implements the bounded workflow. Material/procedure-specific numerical limits or process-response laws require caller-owned qualification inputs; no universal law follows from these records. The latest child paths also include single-face and transient cell/time activity-corrected Nernst–Planck transport, caller activity-based reversible rate snapshots, a co-integrated balanced activity-based reactive-transport solver, and exact-condition repassivation potential margin screening. These remain caller-input paths: activity coefficients and kinetics are not generated or qualified, full reaction-network speciation/ionic strength self-consistency and competing-phase transitions are not solved in one coupled evolving system, and wall laws remain condition/provider dependent. Keep the broad parent scope open pending a bounded direct coupling path and a complete residual audit. The caller-pinned repassivation-margin screen has been added for susceptibility-oriented measured-potential comparisons at exact matched knots. It produces only a signed threshold margin and uncertainty band, not a probability or electrochemical prediction. Existing activity-corrected transport/kinetics APIs and this data comparison remain independent bounded pieces; complete reaction-network speciation, self-consistent activity/ionic-strength coupling, competing phase transition behavior, direct moving-geometry coupling and qualified wall laws remain unresolved. Do not treat the broad parent as technically complete until those self-contained couplings are implemented or fully decomposed as provider/data/qualification residuals. Static scope reconciliation now counts only the registered sour-environment applicability/evidence API as bounded code complete; the unresolved coupled chemistry and full-parent residual audit above remain open. The provider_dependent classification and all physical qualification caveats are retained.
remaining_implementation: The bounded caller-qualified sour-environment applicability/evidence check is implemented and registered. Qualified limits and evidence remain provider-owned; coupled reaction-network prediction, crack growth, life, probability and acceptance remain outside this bounded path.

items.description: Restricted-transport crevice chemistry and susceptibility

Remaining code gap: dynamic electrode potential/double-layer/Faradaic feedback in the same BDF trial. Competing-solid equilibrium is bounded to caller-declared candidates; discovering phases beyond that set requires an external data provider. Procedure-qualified wall laws and independent experimental validation remain pending.
remaining_implementation: Integrate dynamic electrode potential and double-layer charge as state variables with spatial electrolyte potential, BDF trial chemistry, and Faradaic branch currents in one same-stage solve. Exact-knot operator-split adapters are insufficient.

Automatic discovery of thermochemical phases outside the explicitly supplied candidate set requires a qualified external data provider; the existing competing-solid equilibrium API evaluates the caller-declared finite set.
Qualify caller wall-reaction laws against independent procedure-specific experiments; evidence-bound input records alone do not establish qualification.

classification_scope: Classification of the bounded implemented APIs and identified extension work; no scientific qualification or universal discipline coverage is claimed.
progress_meaning: implemented_unverified means the bounded listed code task was added; no test, physical qualification or whole-domain completion is asserted.
evidence_meaning: AST symbol/path/content evidence only; no model execution or testing. Presence does not prove algorithm correctness, full domain implementation or goal completion.
source_audit_meaning: File existence and SHA-256 only. Presence is not proof of symbol-level behavior, full-domain implementation, execution, correctness, or qualification.
ast_audit_meaning: AST parsing and declared class/function names provide navigation evidence only. They do not link a declared symbol to a capability's full behavior or validate execution.

trace_coverage.meaning: Traceability measures source/evidence navigation and static presence only; it does not measure implementation completeness, execution, correctness, or qualification.
